value.rationale: The 48-line Fermat configuration is a canonical, heavily studied example on a complex quartic K3. Its graph Jacobian is a natural exact integral obstruction group for chip-firing and image of its incidence Laplacian; spectral and edge data do not reveal it. Determining the complete 47-factor Smith form identifies all obstructions and separates the graph 3- and 5-primary torsion from the known Picard discriminant \(2^6\). The calculation is a substantive finite structural classification on a motivated object, not an arbitrary slice, and is useful in comparative studies of highly symmetric line configurations.
